source_title: 2025 Sole Source Letter for Flock Safety Public Safety Solutions
evidence_excerpt: This letter serves to confirm that Flock Group Inc. d/b/a Flock Safety is the sole provider of our proprietary public safety technology solution... specifically designed for use by law enforcement.
notes: Council ordinance authorizing Flock agreement was pending approval at the Oct 13 2025 agenda date; sole-source letter (Aug 12 2025) confirms Flock as sole provider. 15 cameras mapped incl. 4 live-view downtown; 14 cameras monitored via credentials; funded via state Blue Shield grant ($50k/yr if awarded); UCM operates 9 cameras in/around campus. MSHP, Johnson Co SO, Jackson Co SO, Holden PD named as Flock customers.

entity_name: University of Central Missouri Department of Public Safety
source_title: City of Warrensburg Police Department Council Communication — Flock Safety Agreement
evidence_excerpt: Currently, the University of Central Missouri has 9 camera's in or around campus (some in our city right of way)... The Warrensburg Investigative Bureau has been granted access credentials to monitor 14 cameras within the city's jurisdiction.
notes: UCM Flock cameras documented in Warrensburg PD council communication.

entity_name: City of St. Charles — Flock Safety Community Program
source_title: Flock Safety Community — City of St. Charles official program page
evidence_excerpt: Together, We Make St. Charles City Safer. This program helps our first responders respond faster and more efficiently during emergencies by providing secure, quick access to cameras throughout our community.
notes: Official city-run Flock Safety community camera program page (camera registration).

source_title: Jefferson City police defend Flock cameras amid privacy concerns
evidence_excerpt: Jefferson City maintains 17 Flock Safety cameras that monitor public streets, according to Police Chief Eric Wilde... data collected by the cameras is retained for 30 days before it is automatically deleted.
notes: June 2025 council approved $51,000 contract renewal for 17 Flock readers; finance packet lists $510,000 projected need over 10 years; 2026 budget notes $85,000 grant for Flock equipment.

source_title: Why some Christian County residents are wary of Flock cameras (Springfield Daily Citizen)
evidence_excerpt: The Daily Citizen obtained contracts between Flock and the Ozark Police Department, Nixa Police Department, Christian County Sheriff's Office and the city of Fremont Hills. Christian County Sheriff's Office 36 months 1 $2,500.
notes: Contract-backed (36-month term, 1 camera, $2,500/yr). Sheriff Brad Cole presented at Jan 15 2026 Flock forum.

source_title: Flock Safety addresses concerns about its cameras in Springfield
evidence_excerpt: Flock Safety cameras are once again coming under fire after tickets were issued after Springfield's No Kings Rally last month.
notes: Active Flock program; Flock Out SGF community group campaigns for removal.

source_title: Jefferson City police defend Flock cameras amid privacy concerns
evidence_excerpt: Mike O'Connell, communications director for the Missouri Department of Public Safety, said the state works directly with Flock in Jefferson City and provides funding for cameras that are managed by local law enforcement.
notes: State-level ALPR program; also cited in Warrensburg sole-source letter as sharing partner.
